<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Jet-Lag|id=A0076}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
The most important thing about jet-lag: there is good jet-lag (when the local time is behind your time because you were flying westwards) and bad jet-lag (when the local time is ahead of your time because you were flying eastwards). Similarly, our keyword has multiple meanings: '''cambio de horario''' – change of schedule/change of time zone/jet-lag.

<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Tengo jet-lag.'''
| I have jet-lag.
| '''¿Qué es eso?'''
| What's that?
| '''El cambio de horario.'''
| The change of time zone.
| '''Ah, claro, porque aquí son ocho horas más.'''
| Oh, of course, because here it's eight hours ahead.
| '''Cierto.'''
| True.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| I have eight hours more.
| '''Tengo ocho horas más.'''
| Why? 
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| Because of ({{=}} '''por''') the change of time zone.
| '''Por el cambio de horario.'''
| What's that?
| '''¿Qué es eso?'''
| Here it's eight hours less ({{=}} '''menos''').
| '''Aquí son ocho horas menos.'''
| True.
| '''Cierto.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| I have eight hours more.
| '''Tengo ocho horas más.'''
| Why? 
| '''¿Por qué?'''
| Because of ({{=}} '''por''') the change of time zone.
| '''Por el cambio de horario.'''
| What's that?
| '''¿Qué es eso?'''
| Here it's eight hours less ({{=}} '''menos''').
| '''Aquí son ocho horas menos.'''
| True.
| '''Cierto.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====

| We have jet-lag.
| '''Tenemos jet-lag.'''
| What's that?
| '''¿Qué es eso?'''
| The change of time zone.
| '''El cambio de horario.'''
| Oh, of course, because here it's one ({{=}} '''una''') hour ahead.
| '''Ah, claro, porque aquí es una hora más.'''
| True.
| '''Cierto.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
